program.section_heading: Associate in Arts in Social Justice Studies: LGBTQ Studies (AA-T) Degree (ACADEMIC PROGRAM CODE: W040202G)
outcomes: Analyze the social and political construction of sexual orientation and gender identity, and how these concepts operate and have operated across social and cultural institutions in the United States and across cultures.
Articulate how concepts of sexual orientation and gender identity intersect and interact with those of race, ethnicity, class, and gender and sexual orientation.
Analyze and evaluate the history of American social movements that have sought justice for oppressed sexual and gender minorities, as well as racial, ethnic, and class minority groups.
Summarize the histories and experiences of LGBTQ+ people in the United States, and critically evaluate their contributions to the fabric of American society.
Identify and analyze policies that have the potential to alleviate inequalities based on sexual orientation and gender identity.
